references.text: The parable of the unmerciful servant illustrates the importance of forgiving others, just as God has forgiven us.
Jesus speaks about forgiving others so that the Father will also forgive us.
James emphasizes that judgment will be without mercy toward anyone who has shown no mercy; mercy triumphs over judgment.
Paul urges believers to be kind to one another and to forgive each other, just as God in Christ forgave you.
Paul exhorts believers to bear with one another and forgive each other if someone has a complaint against another; just as the Lord forgave you, so also must you forgive.
